text.en:
The barangays of Tangklao, Piangamanganan, Kadayonan, Lupitan, Punud, Kabasaran,
Pantau-Raya, Kablanga, Pantaon, Nunungen, Lumbaka-Ingud, and Tadoken in the municipality of
Pantau-Ragat, and the barangays of Lumbaka-Ingud, Pened, Domiorog, Daramba, Nunang, Sulo, Caromatan,
Tagoranao, Madamba, Lumbatan, Madaya, Bobong-Dinaig, Linindingan, Maliwanag, Dinaig, Timbangalan,
Pindolonan, and Alowin in the municipality of Matungao, all in the province of Lanao del Norte, are hereby
separated from said municipalities and constituted into a distinct and independent municipality to be known as
the municipality of Poona-Piagapo in the province of Lanao del Norte. The seat of the new municipality shall
be located at the barangay of Poona-Piagapo to be established within the proximity of Barangay
Lumbaka-Ingud.

The President shall appoint the mayor, vice-mayor, and councilors of the municipality of
Poona-Piagapo who shall hold office until their successors shall have been elected or appointed, as the case

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 31st day of March, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-six.
